isolation.basis: Dedicated owned candidate and published baseline checkouts with all native bytes and declared inputs frozen; all own functional/build/review workers and execution commands terminated; fresh current-namespace process/resource observation shows only this finite declaration writer and its ancestors in the owned checkouts. The official controller performs a single nonblocking acquisition of the current shared performance mutex, rechecks source and visible own work, serializes all four series in one supervised group, and retains 30-second namespace observations.
isolation.scope: Prospectively scoped official ABBA comparison within this owned execution window and the currently shared performance mutex. No universal host or cross-namespace quiet claim.
limitations: Ordinary concurrent work in other execution namespaces or on the host is not observable from this namespace and is not asserted absent.
No peer availability or historical epoch acknowledgment is required. The mutex serializes holders of its current inode; it does not suspend ordinary work.
CPU affinity and load are observed rather than assigned as exclusive CPU resources. Periodic controller observations are retained measurement instrumentation.

session_elapsed covers the harness controller through final acquired return, including pause/resume; worker startup, begin, terminal inspection, close, live game engine, network and browser rendering are excluded.
